title: Applicability of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.scenario: A consumer from the state of Jammu and Kashmir wants to file a complaint against a company for a defective product.
content.outcome: The Consumer Protection Act, 2019 does not apply to the state of Jammu and Kashmir, and therefore, the consumer cannot file a complaint under this Act.

user_queries: Is the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 applicable in Jammu and Kashmir?
Can a consumer from Jammu and Kashmir file a complaint under this Act?
What are the implications of the Act not applying to Jammu and Kashmir?
